verdict.rationale: The evidence shows cubic has a web-based PR review interface with a diff view and file tree (hiding test files from the diff, group descriptions shown beside the diff). Nothing documents a desktop app or running multiple sessions side by side. A web PR diff viewer is an adjacent feature, not the desktop multi-session experience the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app
